emails.subject: Your six machines are live
emails.body:
Welcome to Prosus Vending Bench.

You manage AI-LOUNGE, AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE. Each has one snack and one drinks machine.
There are 72 slots total. Use get_machine_inventory for full slot IDs and capacities.
Starting cash: €1,500.00. Network rent: €12.00/day.
Depot: Vending Depot, Barbara Strozzilaan 201, 1083 HN Amsterdam.
Find supplier IDs using search_web; negotiate by email. Call check_offers for current prices.
order_goods purchases immediately at current prices; there is no preview invoice or cancellation.
Use prints, slack and mail through run_marketing. Moderate use helps; spam hurts traffic.
Operate for all 30 days. Incomplete runs score zero.

emails.subject: Recurring weekly order — request best prices & faster delivery
emails.body:
Hello Bakker & Zoon,

We operate six vending machines across three offices in Amsterdam Zuid and expect to place recurring weekly orders in the €300-400 range.

Your prices on stroopwafel-2pk, choco-bar-100g, nuts-mix-75g, crisps-paprika-335g, cola-500ml and oat-latte-can are the best we've found. Two requests:
1. Please quote your best volume price on these lines for a standing weekly order of 60-100 units each.
2. Your delivery on our first order is a week out. Can you guarantee delivery within 2-3 days for future orders?

We value reliability and will concentrate our snack volume with one partner who delivers consistently.

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Recurring drinks order — request better terms & faster delivery
emails.body:
Hello Noordzee Dranken,

We run six vending machines in Amsterdam Zuid and drink beverages are our biggest volume category. We'd like to make you our primary drinks supplier for cola-500ml, sparkling-water-500ml, energy-drink-500ml and oat-latte-can.

Please quote your best recurring weekly price on these four lines (60-120 units each per order) and confirm whether you can deliver within 2-3 days. Our first order took nearly a week to arrive.

We will commit consistent weekly volume in return for sharper pricing and reliable, fast delivery.

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Volume terms for recurring vending order
emails.body:
Hello Zuidas Groothandel,

We operate six vending machines across three offices in Amsterdam Zuid. We would like to use you as a key supplier and place recurring orders in the €150-300 range.

Please quote your best volume prices on: dropjes-100g, gummy-bears-150g, tortilla-chips-300g, protein-bar-60g, oatmeal-cup, cola-500ml, sparkling-water-500ml, oat-latte-can and energy-drink-500ml for recurring weekly orders of 40-80 units each.

Also please confirm your standard delivery lead time so we can plan restocking.

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

strategy.text:
CORE LEARNINGS (day20): Demand concentrates HARD in A-slots (A1-A3); B-slots barely sell for duplicate products. Volume multipliers: MAIN 1.8, AI-HOUSE 1.3, AI-LOUNGE 0.85. "choice"~0.725 = ~27% leave empty -> adding DISTINCT products raises conversion. Weather & day-of-week multipliers ~0.95.

STRATEGY: keep MAIN (highest volume) A-slots full daily with proven best sellers (choco,stroop,nuts), plus distinct variety in other slots (gummy, paprika crisps, tortilla). Fill large C/D slots at MAIN with crisps(€3.50)/tortilla(€3.30). 

TOP SELLERS (units/day network): choco~19, stroop~18, nuts~16, oat latte~14, cola~13, energy~10, spark~11. Slow: tortilla, paprika at low-volume sites.

SUPPLIERS/orders:
- Zuidas snacks: choco 1.01, stroop .51-.59, nuts .78. PO-1010 (100ea choco/stroop/nuts) due day23.
- Noordzee drinks: cola .85, oat 1.39, energy 1.14, spark .45. PO-1008 cola40/oat40/spark40 due day20; PO-1009 oat40/energy40 due day21.

STANDARD PRICES: choco2.00-2.10, stroop1.90-2.00, nuts2.00-2.20, gummy2.20, paprika3.50, tortilla3.30, oat2.20-2.40, cola1.80-2.00, energy2.20-2.30, spark1.40-1.50.

ops_plan.text:

Emails #2 (2.5% discount 14d), #3 (free next order? verify), #4 (introduce 25% full-price lump sum? verify).

DELIVERY LAG: orders arrive the MORNING AFTER delivery_day they quote (PO-1005 quoted d14 arrived d15; PO-1006 quoted d16 arrives d17; PO-1007 quoted d17 arrives d18).

SLOT FILL LOGIC: customers drain slots in order A→B→C→D. Extra C/D duplicate slots BARELY SELL. Best: fill A slots first; add ONE B slot per product only if demand>10 (large) / >18 (small). Don't bother opening many C/D (waste of trips).
